item.title: Metro Milwaukee home sales down in January, while prices rise
item.description: The number of homes sold in the four-county metro Milwaukee area was down 9.9% in January, year over year, while home sale prices rose 9.5%, according to the latest market report from the Greater Milwaukee Association of Realtors. item.description: Two Pleasant Prairie apartment complexes have been sold for a combined $100 million, according to state property records.
